scope: Yeti melee, ice spikes/cluster/projectile, barrage and Glacial Shove; FrozenSkeleton short noncombat disposition.
summary: Yeti native melee/ice HP separated from iframe/freeze/control; swept magic versus real playerTouch freeze, terrain spawn admission, resource/reload predicates and roll-aware shove resolved.

facts.melee: Yeti uses server tick state callbacks; its chase goal only navigates. Frame = timer - 2. SWIPE_1 frame21 and SWIPE_2 frame28 query a Living box of full side8 at yaw-forward2.5/Y2; they set frozen160, reset invulnerableTime=0, request shared attack scale.8, then displace victims. PUNCH frame18 uses side8 forward2.5/Y1.5, frozen320, iframe reset and scale.8. GROUND_SMASH frame19 uses side8 forward3/Y1.5, frozen320, iframe reset and scale1.2. LEAP_SMASH elapsed50 (countdown20) uses side4 at Y+2, frozen320 and scale1 WITHOUT an iframe reset. Selection excludes only this Yeti: no canFreeze, LOS, team or creative filter. Source is mob_attack, direct and causing entity Yeti; shared helper computes current ATTACK_DAMAGE*scale then native enchantment modification. Scale only its final hurt amount.
facts.melee_control: Frozen writes and iframe resets precede damage; displacement follows regardless of the returned boolean. Swipe1/2 add ((victim-Yeti)/fullDistance + perpendicular look vector*+/-2.5)*1.5 in XZ; punch uses factor2, ground smash3.5 plus Y+.8, leap1.5 preserving Y. Swipe1 frames24..31 also pushes outward.5 from a side6 box at backward2.5/Y2; swipe2 frame25 pushes outward1.5 there. These use direct velocity, not Living.knockback resistance/event. Leap also moves Yeti upward1.8 (3.8 in water), homes toward its target and dives; overhead block clearing checks mobGriefing and destroy speed>0,<50, with no extra HP payload. Keep these controls native and preserve R2i5a state-dispatch predicates.
facts.ice_producers: Ground smash also calls iceWave(range20,count60,damage=attack*.7,speed1.5). Leap elapsed50 also calls iceBurst(range8,count40,damage=attack*.7,cluster chance1/20). Barrage frames43/74 (elapsed45/76) call delayedBurst at the current target: range1, count10/20, damage=attack*.2/.4, delay10. Frame109 creates owner-Yeti Glacial Shove, delay10, shouldSetAttack=false. With a nonnull target and usedUltimate<3, that frame increments the resource and restarts barrage: starting at1 allows three uninterrupted cycles. The third does not restart. Native counts, delays and resource flags are not Stage values.
facts.burst_geometry: Each helper attempts count candidates; terrain can reject them. Burst helpers clamp pitch to +/-85, normalize horizontal direction*range and rotate each offset by a random full-circle yaw; distance multiplier=(j+1)/35+.25. Wave uses horizontal input direction*range, multiplier=(j+1)/35 and yaw +/-40; its range20 argument is not a hard20-block cap at count60. placeProper rays vertically from candidate XZ at owner eye height to wantedY-3, Block.COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE; MISS skips. It does not require eye-to-candidate LOS. Helpers set damage and ownerUUID, normal spike scale clamped1..4, and evil when owner is Yeti. Evil is read only by renderers. Wave delay=16+floor(j/1.5), radial burst delay=floor(sqrt(16+j)), delayed burst delay10. Wave/delayed cluster chance1/10; leap uses1/20. Do not scale both setDamage and the later hurt.
facts.spike_admission_and_payload: Both spike classes use IceSpikeEntity.canHurt: exclude resolved owner; exclude an OwnableEntity only when its ownerUUID is the SAME OBJECT as the spike UUID (reference comparison, not UUID.equals); require alive, nonspectator, not IceSpike or Cluster. No canFreeze, team or LOS test. First server baseTick applies Slowness20 ticks amplifier1 to admitted Living in its BB. At exact tickCount==delay, request ownerless freeze for stored damage, then independently set frozen200. Cluster additionally requires !held. Damage defaults10 and native helpers replace it. Normal spike dimensions1x1 scale .4/.6/.8/1; cluster2x2, held scale.1. Normal spike discards when prior spawn-animation counter==11; cluster when counter>=400+delay, with held state pausing activation/expiry. Damage occurs only at exact delay, not every contact tick. Scale each final freeze hurt request once.
facts.cluster_resource_and_reload: Cluster hurt ignores damage amount/source and inherited HP: with zero hit-animation counter, remainingHit(default5)>1 decrements and starts an8-tick lockout; otherwise removes KILLED. Returns true on an admitted resource hit, false during lockout. Native ICE_GAUNTLET interaction with an available attachment slot0..3 stores the cluster UUID, starts use, sets held, transfers ownership to player and replaces remainingHit with the slot index. Holding shrinks its BB; it releases when the resolved ServerPlayer stops using. Equipment input/shooting remains later work. Spike/cluster save lowercase owner, delay, age and control/resource fields but NOT configured damage, which returns to10 on reload. A held cluster that misses exact delay does not replay its strike on release. No Stage scaling of break counts or holding.
facts.barrage_aura: While barrage timer<=180 and (usedUltimate>1 OR timer>20), every server tick selects entities in Yeti BB.inflate(3,5,3) with canFreeze=true and not Yeti, then Living only. Shared attackEntity uses scale.225 and explicit ownerless freeze source; current Yeti attack attribute and enchantment modification still apply. Returned boolean is ignored; frozen200 follows independently. No explicit iframe reset. Scale only the final shared hurt argument.
facts.projectile_delivery: THROW_SPIKE frame25 requires a target. Calm emits one native IceSpikeProjectile with baseDamage=int(attack*.2); enraged emits three at yaw-20/0/+20 with int(attack*.3). Speed4, inaccuracy0, ownerYeti, knockback8, silent. It extends Projectile, not AbstractArrow. Swept hit uses indirect_magic, direct=self, causing=owner or self fallback, amount ceil(clamp(speed*baseDamage,0,INT_MAX)). Owner Living lastHurtMob is set before hurt. On hurt true, non-Enderman Living gets knockback scaled by max(0,1-KBresistance)*knockback*.6 in XZ and Y.1, plus Slowness60 amplifier1. OwnerYeti hitting a Player at distance10..20 requests RANGED_CONTROL. Then breakIce discards; hurt false also breaks and restores previous fire ticks; hurt-true Enderman returns before those callbacks. A natively burning projectile attempts5-second ignition before damage and restores it on failure. Tick preserves collider ray, expanded-BB1 native canHitEntity/owner/vehicle admission, PvP, Neo ProjectileImpact veto and native deflection. Block impact breaks. Drag.99 (.6 water), gravity.05. Base damage and owner persist; custom knockback resets0 on reload. Static shoot helpers have no external native invokestatic callers. Gauntlet constructor producer remains equipment review. Scale final ceil hurt only.
facts.projectile_player_touch: A second legitimate route is Player.aiStep -> touch -> IceSpikeProjectile.playerTouch. Player requires HP>0 and not spectator, and visits nonremoved entities in BB.inflate(1,.5,1); riding uses vehicle-union BB.inflate(1,0,1). The callback excludes only player==owner, sets frozen200, then server requests explicit FREEZE8 (direct spike, nullable causing owner), applies Slowness60 amplifier1, optionally requests Yeti ranged control at10..20, and discards. All secondary actions ignore hurt result. No canFreeze, ProjectileImpact or PvP check in this callback. Native movement, entity order and removal determine swept magic versus touch freezing; do not fabricate or force both. Scale final FREEZE8 once.
facts.glacial_shove: RANGED_CONTROL timer25 creates a shove for a ServerPlayer target, ownerYeti, delay11, shouldSetAttack=true. Barrage frame109 accepts any Living target, delay10, shouldSetAttack=false. Before delay it follows the target ID using a downward10-block collider ray. At exact delay it requires a resolved Yeti owner and processes all entities in its3x2.5 BB. Invulnerable rolling ServerPlayers are skipped entirely; other Living have no Roll, owner, LOS or freeze-eligibility exclusion. Velocity adds (ownerPos-victimPos)*.15 plus Y1.5; ServerPlayers use SpatialUtil with native client push packet, others raw Living.push. Slowness100 amplifier2 follows; NO HP damage. worked means an eligible entity was processed, not that the effect applied. On server with shouldSetAttack: worked buffers PUNCH; failure requests LEAP_SMASH. It becomes collidable after delay and expires after180; fire/explosion immune. Save writes Owner, read expects owner; only tick_count otherwise persists. Target/delay/shouldSetAttack revert to -1/31/true. A normal reload loses owner resolution and hence the payload. Preserve this behavior; no repair authorized.
facts.freeze_counter_vs_HP: setTicksFrozen writes a synchronized counter, not a MobEffect, and does not check canFreeze. RollMixin can reject the write. Living aiStep outside powder snow decays2; fully frozen means>=140, and each40 server ticks fully frozen+canFreeze requests ownerless freeze1. canFreeze excludes spectators, FREEZE_IMMUNE_ENTITY_TYPES and any FREEZE_IMMUNE_WEARABLES in five equipment slots. Frost applies additive movement speed -.05*min(counter,140)/140 when the standing block is not air. Direct FREEZE hurt does not call canFreeze; IS_FREEZING damage against FREEZE_HURTS_EXTRA_TYPES is multiplied5 in native Living.hurt. Thus wearables may block aura/passive HP without blocking a direct spike/touch request. Slowness still uses native Applicable/Roll/merging. Scale passive freeze only once at its final hurt argument, with proven origin attribution; never also scale counter duration or unrelated powder snow.
facts.sources_and_exclusions: mob_attack is Neo physical; indirect_magic is Neo magic, armor/shield bypass, NOT is_projectile; freeze is environment/IS_FREEZING, armor/shield bypass and no_knockback. None bypass Resistance, effects, enchantments, invulnerability or cooldown. All three use when_caused_by_living_non_player difficulty scaling. Ownerless spike/aura/passive freeze loses Yeti credit; explicit playerTouch may retain its owner. Future integration needs runtime source/provenance fixtures. FrozenSkeleton is a plain Entity decorative break prop: five admitted non-debug-stick server hits with an8-tick lockout remove it; no outgoing attack/status/Living HP. Short NO_STAGE_VALUE exclusion only. Rendering, particles, sounds and acquisition excluded. Yeti combat review is complete with R2i5a; player Gauntlet input/delivery remains equipment work and must reuse these payloads.
